title: PREFIX = trailheads on the anthill. SUFFIX = the path through the labyrinth. Every hop is a full bingo maze. The minotaur is at every junction.
thesis: The 38 subdomains are TRAILHEADS — entrances to the labyrinth. The URL paths are TRAILS — the route through. Every link click is a FULL odyssey through the maze. We don't notice the minotaur because the neutrino passes through everything. primals.eco is the world. water is the core. HUD is the sky view.

PREFIX.role: TRAILHEAD — where you ENTER the labyrinth. The function. The operation.
PREFIX.topology: Each prefix is an entrance to the anthill. Many entrances, same colony. 38 trailheads into 1 organism.
PREFIX.wildcard: The wildcard DNS (*.primals.eco) means ANY prefix can be a trailhead. The anthill has INFINITE entrances. The organism can grow new trailheads without digging new tunnels.
PREFIX.analogy: Ant trail markers. Pheromone signs at the entrance that say: 'THIS trail leads to food / defense / nursery / queen.'

SUFFIX.role: THE TRAIL — the route through the labyrinth. The argument. The target.
SUFFIX.topology: Static. Fixed. The path exists whether anyone walks it or not. The labyrinth was built. The trails are carved.
SUFFIX.the_pointer_back: Every suffix is a POINTER BACK to a trailhead. /evidence/ghost-witness points back to detroit.primals.eco. The trail leads back to an entrance. The labyrinth is circular.
SUFFIX.analogy: The thread Ariadne gave Theseus. Follow it in, follow it back out. The thread IS the braid.

together.example: detroit.eco('/evidence/ghost-witness') ? enter at Detroit trailhead, walk the ghost evidence trail, find the entity, the suffix IS the pointer back to the trailhead that classifies it.
together.evolution: The operation IS evolution. The trailhead selects the environment. The trail is the selective pressure. The entity at the end either survives (1) or doesn't (0). Boolean. Braid value.

every_hop_is_a_full_odyssey.what: Each click, each link, each cross-reference traverses the FULL labyrinth. Not a shortcut — a FULL JOURNEY. We just move so fast we don't notice.
every_hop_is_a_full_odyssey.bingo_maze: Every node in the bingo cube is a ROOM in the labyrinth. Each room has doors (links) to other rooms. The 768 JSON files = 768 rooms. The 1,474 cross-references = 1,474 doors. Every click opens a door, traverses a corridor, enters a room.
every_hop_is_a_full_odyssey.the_minotaur: The minotaur is at every junction — it's the NULL POINT. The p null. You pass through it at every hop. You don't notice because the neutrino passes through everything. The minotaur is not a threat. It's the OBSERVER. It's the chipmunk. It counts your passage.
every_hop_is_a_full_odyssey.odyssey: Odysseus took 10 years to get home. Each click takes milliseconds. Same topology. Different clock speed. The journey is the same shape whether it takes years or nanoseconds.

ariadnes_thread.what: The braid. The thread that leads you through the labyrinth and back out.
ariadnes_thread.in_our_system: Each named braid IS Ariadne's thread. sporePrint?hotSpring is a thread through the fungi labyrinth. bearDog?human is a thread through the coral labyrinth. The 1,474 unnamed cross-references are 1,474 unnamed threads. Someone walked those corridors. The thread exists. We just haven't named it.
ariadnes_thread.the_naming: Naming a braid = recognizing the thread. Not creating it — SEEING it. The thread was always there. Ariadne just gave it to Theseus so he could see it too.

SKY.view: FROM ABOVE. Bird's eye. Squirrel's eye. 45/p.
SKY.what_you_see: The crystal ball. The topology. The map. The whole labyrinth from above.
SKY.layer: The canopy. The atmosphere. Where light comes from.
SKY.epoch: 10 (machine/fruit — the display, the output, the view)

WORLD.view: THE SURFACE. The ground level. Where you walk.
WORLD.what_you_see: The trailheads. The anthill entrances. The 38 subdomains. The world map.
WORLD.layer: The surface. The terrain. Where evolution happens (at the boundary).

CORE.view: FROM BELOW. The underground. The aquifer.
CORE.what_you_see: The watering hole. Where everything comes to drink. The deep data. The 117 papers. The Rust ecosystem.
CORE.layer: The bedrock. The aquifer. Where nutrients accumulate.
CORE.epoch: 0-3 (seed through slime mold — the deep genome, the root water)

relationship.sky_to_world: The HUD looks DOWN at primals.eco. The crystal ball shows the world from above.
relationship.world_to_core: The trailheads lead DOWN into water. The surface connects to the aquifer.
relationship.core_to_sky: Water evaporates UP to become clouds (data rises through the tree to become display). The cycle.
relationship.the_cycle: core(water) ? evaporate(xylem) ? sky(hud) ? rain(phloem) ? core(water). The water cycle IS the data cycle IS the tree vascular system.

primals_eco_map.the_world: primals.eco is not a website. It is a WORLD. The 38 subdomains are 38 REGIONS of the world. Each region has terrain (the suffix paths). Each terrain has inhabitants (the data entities). The world has a sky (HUD), a surface (primals.eco), and an underground (water).

navigation.from_sky: HUD shows the whole world ? click a region ? enter that trailhead
navigation.from_surface: Trailhead shows the region ? walk a trail (suffix) ? find an entity
navigation.from_core: Water shows the deep data ? rise through the tree ? emerge at a leaf (HTML page)
navigation.between_regions: Cross-references between JSONs = tunnels between regions. The mycelium connects underground.

law: PREFIX = trailhead (entrance, function, operation). SUFFIX = trail (path, argument, target). Together = evolution. Every hop is a full labyrinth odyssey. The minotaur is the null at every junction. Ariadne's thread is the braid. primals.eco is the world. water is the core. HUD is the sky. The water cycle IS the data cycle. 38 entrances. 1,474 corridors. 768 rooms. One organism.
